title: ASTRA-bench: Evaluating Tool-Use Agent Reasoning and Action Planning with Personal User Context
abstract: arXiv:2603.01357v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Next-generation AI must manage vast personal data, diverse tools, and multi-step reasoning, yet most benchmarks remain context-free and single-turn. We present ASTRA-bench (Assistant Skills in Tool-use, Reasoning \& Action-planning), a benchmark that uniquely unifies time-evolving personal context with an interactive toolbox and complex user intents. Our event-driven pipeline generates 2,413 scenarios across four protagonists, grounded in longitudinal life events and annotated by referential, functional, and informational complexity. Evaluation of state-of-the-art models (e.g., Claude-4.5-Opus, DeepSeek-V3.2) reveals significant performance degradation under high-complexity conditions, with argument generation emerging as the primary bottleneck. translated_title: ASTRA-bench：基于个人用户情境评估工具使用智能体的推理与行动规划
translated_abstract: 下一代人工智能必须管理海量的个人数据、多样化的工具以及多步骤推理，然而现有的多数基准测试仍然是无上下文的单轮测试。我们提出了 ASTRA-bench（工具使用、推理与行动规划中的助手技能），这是一个独特地将随时间演变的个人情境与交互式工具箱及复杂用户意图相统一的基准测试。我们的事件驱动流程基于纵向生活事件生成了覆盖四名主人公的 2,413 个场景，并按照指代复杂性、功能复杂性和信息复杂性进行了标注。对最先进模型（如 Claude-4.5-Opus、DeepSeek-V3.2）的评估显示，这些模型在高复杂性条件下出现显著的性能下降，其中工具参数生成成为主要瓶颈。这些发现揭示了当前智能体在将推理锚定于杂乱的个人情境以及编排可靠多步骤计划方面的关键局限性。我们公开发布了 ASTRA-bench……
tldr: ASTRA-bench 是首个将随时间演变的个人用户情境与交互式工具箱和复杂用户意图相统一的工具智能体评测基准，其基于纵向生活事件构建的 2,413 个场景揭示了现有最先进模型在高复杂性条件下性能显著下降、参数生成是主要瓶颈的问题。
en_tdlr: ASTRA-bench is the first benchmark to unify time-evolving personal user context with an interactive toolbox and complex user intents, and its 2,413 event-driven scenarios grounded in longitudinal life events reveal significant performance degradation in state-of-the-art tool-use agents, with argument generation as the primary bottleneck.
